title: Progress Log
description: Checkpoint unfinished work while its claim is held, before a wait, handoff or release. Read live status after automatic completion; terminal items already record results and evidence, so skip the final append and do not reacquire a claim solely for a checkpoint. Keep each entry body at or below 4,096 UTF-8 bytes; write only what changed and the next step, and move evidence to artifacts or field-notes.
